runners.comment: Runner-up on turf on debut but was then well held switched to dirt next time in Argentina. Left Luciano Cerutti after and has work to do giving weight all round.
Foaled May 8. $75,000 2-y-o, Vekoma filly. Half-sister to a winner. Behind in barrier trial at Jebel Ali earlier this month. Others preferred.

€100,000 2-y-o, Justify filly. 100/1, eighth of 12 in maiden at Kempton (7f) on debut 44 days ago, doing some good work late on. Should be suited by further and she's open to improvement, though must do to reverse form with Miss Trickster.

Foaled February 18. $200,000 2-y-o, Authentic filly. Half-sister to a US minor stakes winner, dam out of US champion female sprinter. Makes appeal on paper though looks down the pecking order on jockey bookings.
Foaled February 21. $30,000 2-y-o, Sharp Azteca filly. Half-sister to a couple of winners, dam sister to a US Grade 1 winner. A cheap purchase but makes some appeal on breeding.

$65,000Y, €100,000 2-y-o, by Practical Joke. 80/1, showed promise when neck second of 12 in maiden at Kempton (7f) on debut 44 days ago. This surface will suit on pedigree and she promises to be tough to beat with requisite improvement.
Foaled February 16. $185,000, Vekoma filly. Half-sister to a winner and has a US Grade 1 winner further back in pedigree. Looks the pick of yard's runners on jockey bookings.
Foaled April 16. $60,000 2-y-o, Greatest Honour filly. Dam half-sister to a US Grade 1 turf winner. Not one to discount on debut.

Won allowance at Horseshoe Indianapolis earlier this year. Well held in similar event when last seen in August. First run for yard after leaving Steven M. Asmussen. Has work to do at the weights now handicapping.
Latest win at Kempton in October. Head second to classy Fast Track Harry there last time. In great form on the all-weather of late but there are question marks over whether he'll handle dirt.
Course winner on debut but that remains her only success. Back on track when second of 9 in handicap (2/1) at Abu Dhabi (6f, good) 22 days ago. Can go well again back on dirt.
Course winner. 28/1, seventh of 9 in handicap at Jebel Ali (5f) on return 20 days ago. Needs to build on that.
Fairly useful performer. 9/1 and in first-time tongue strap, fourth of 9 in handicap at Jebel Ali (5f) 20 days ago. Could go well back here.
Runner-up on final 2 starts in Saudi Arabia but was last of 6 in minor event at this course 2 weeks ago. Has work to do.
C&D winner. Bit below form tenth of 16 in handicap (18/1) at this course (7f) when last seen 8 months ago. Is now just 2 lb above last winning mark and could go well on return.
Failed to feature in 2 minor events at this course last season. Makes little appeal from this mark.
Made the frame at Jebel Ali on second start and was seemingly flattered on the turf at this course next time. Well beaten after and still looks too high in the weights even off his lower dirt mark.
Long-standing maiden. Last of 9 in handicap at Jebel Ali (5f, 9/2) 20 days ago. Hard to make a case for.
One win from 24 Flat runs. Well held all 3 starts this year and easily passed over.
Has little solid form to his name since winning here in December 2024.

Foaled March 19. 160,000 gns 2-y-o, Omaha Beach colt. Half-brother to a US winner. Has some black type winners further back in pedigree. Fourth in recent Jebel Ali barrier trial. Tongue tied on debut.
Foaled February 21. $140,000 2-y-o, Nashville colt. Half-brother to several winners, dam half-sister to a US Grade 2 winner. Comfortably beaten in barrier trial here last month.

$105,000Y, resold $250,000Y, Tiz The Law colt. 2/1, needed experience when fifth of 10 in maiden at Kempton (7f) on debut in September. His strength in the betting on debut was notable and he can do better in first-time blinkers.
Modest gelding. Sixth of 10 in maiden at this course (6f, 28/1) 14 days ago. Has work to do.
Foaled March 30. $70,000 2-y-o, Corniche colt. Half-brother to a minor stakes winner in US. Dam related to a couple of stakes winners.
Foaled April 3. $55,000 2-y-o, Mandaloun colt. Half-brother to a winner in Korea. Has several black-type performers further back in pedigree.

Foaled April 25. $275,000 2-y-o, Army Mule colt. Half-brother to several winners, with plenty of black type performers in pedigree. Looks stable's first string on jockey bookings and is a newcomer to note.
$35,000F, $60,000Y, Oscar Performance colt. Hinted at some ability when sixth of 14 in novice (80/1) at Southwell (7f) on debut 32 days ago.

$41,000Y, €100,000 2-y-o, Hard Spun colt. 80/1, held back by inexperience when sixth of 11 in maiden at Kempton (1m) on debut 51 days ago, though was getting the hang of things late on. Bred for dirt and should build on that run.
Foaled March 20. $215,000 2-y-o, Mo Donegal colt. Half-brother to several winners. Probably best watched on debut.
Foaled February 6. $200,000 2-y-o, Mandaloun colt. Well beaten on barrier trial here last month. Choice of O'Shea.
Fourth of 10 in maiden (10/1) at this course (6f) on debut 14 days ago, pulling clear of rest. Sets the standard and is the one to beat.
Foaled March 25. $195,000Y, Honor A. P. colt. Half-brother to a couple of winners, with pedigree chock full of black type performers. Third in barrier trial here recently. A newcomer to note.
Former US-trained horse who won twice in 2024, latter in Santa Anita Grade 1. Missed following season and has failed to kick on this year. Can only be watched starting out for new stable.
C&D winner. 7/1, won 11-runner listed race at Jebel Ali (9.7f) by short head from Arlan when last seen in February. Has to be taken seriously on handicap debut.
Had a good time of it last season, winning at Jebel Ali twice. Better off at the weights with Killer Collect on their listed meeting at that course in February. Could be the way to go.

Five wins from 18 Flat runs. First run since leaving Simon & Ed Crisford when winning 10-runner handicap at Jebel Ali (7f, 33/1) 20 days ago. Remains on a handy mark and just as effective over this longer trip.
Twice a winner on all-weather in North America in 2025. Unplaced both starts this year and is hard to make a case for on first start since leaving Josie Carroll.
18/1, career best when winning 9-runner handicap at this course (11f) 8 months ago. That was his fourth course success and he could go well again on his return.

A 3-time winner at Jebel Ali. Struggled to make an impression on turf in Britain last 2 starts, albeit on soft ground latest. Has dropped to an attractive mark but has yet to fully prove his effectiveness at this track.
Won Jebel Ali maiden last December and placed twice there after. This is a deeper race and others are preferred.
Smart gelding and a 3-time C&D winner, including this last year and a Group 3 back in January. Last seen with a respectable third in Godolphin Mile here in March. Big shout on return.
Useful horse. Dead-heated in Jebel Ali Mile earlier this year. Comfortably held here next 2 starts. Might need this.
Smart gelding. 3-time C&D winner. Was found out in a higher grade earlier on this year but should be suited by this ease in grade and will be doing his best work late on.

Developed into a useful performer last season, winning 4 of his 7 starts. 16/1, creditable 5¾ lengths fourth of 12 to Banishing in Godolphin Mile over C&D when last seen in March. Entitled to be in the mix.

runners.abnormalReason: ride_description: Useful performer who made the frame twice in 2025. Looked quirky when below form in Earl of Sefton Stakes at Newmarket on sole outing to date this year. Pedigre
runners.comment: Useful performer who made the frame twice in 2025. Looked quirky when below form in Earl of Sefton Stakes at Newmarket on sole outing to date this year. Pedigree doesn't suggest he'll relish this surface.
Smart colt who won twice at Jebel Ali in March. 8½ lengths eighth of 12 to Banishing in Godolphin Mile (28/1) over C&D when last seen 7 months ago.
Showed smart form in US when trained by Chad C. Brown though hasn't been seen since finishing tailed off in Travers at Saratoga in August 2025. Can only be watched on return.
Useful gelding with only one success under his belt. 9/2, respectable third of 7 in handicap at this course (1m) 14 days ago, doing too much too soon. Should come on for that and could go well.
Seven wins from 16 Flat runs. 2/1, wasn't disgraced when third of 6 in minor event over C&D 14 days ago. Needs to pull out a bit more.
Turf winner here in early-2025. Highly tried since but others more persuasive returning in a handicap.
Three-time course winner, capitalising on a falling mark over C&D back in February. Back on a workable mark following his reappearance a fortnight ago.
Lightly-raced colt who has won both starts at Jebel Ali, latest on return just 20 days ago. Significantly back up in trip and makes handicap debut. More required.
C&D winner on debut but has failed to trouble the judge since, the first-time visor not working last time. Off 10 months and others more persuasive.
Unexposed colt. Made frame on last 2 starts in maidens over C&D. Isn't one to write off now starting out in handicaps.
